name: Angie's Restaurant (Logan) 1/2-Lb Charbroiled Angus Burger vs. Country Chicken Fried Steak
whyItWorks: Angie's charbroiled California Burger (topped with avocado and naturally lactose-safe Swiss cheese) on a white bun is much easier to digest than the breaded Chicken Fried Steak.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the California Burger (beef patty, Swiss cheese, avocado, and bun—no raw onion or tomato) instead of the deep-fried Chicken Fried Steak.
watchOuts: Chicken Fried Steak with country sausage gravy is high in fried fat and black pepper
